consequences: Pre-commit still blocks a commit with a secret. Clean records keep flowing to .sati/ meanwhile.
context: Review follow-up 1.1. The all-or-nothing export failed every later debounced batch once one record held a secret, so nothing was exported again and the only message was on MCP stderr. Write-time refusal now covers tasks, decisions, features and milestones, so the export check is a backstop for records that reached the DB another way.
decision: exportSnapshot scans each changed record, writes the clean ones and returns the rest in `refused`. `sati sync export` (pre-commit) still exits 5 when anything is refused; the debounced export reports once and does not re-queue the record. Replaces the all-or-nothing throw in snapshot.ts.
title: Export skips a record with a secret instead of refusing the whole export
